part.text:
I couldn't publish the post. The task is not done, and nothing was posted.

The environment has no way to tap or type on the simulator. `simctl` can take screenshots and open URLs, but not send touches. I tried the Bluesky compose deep link (`bluesky://intent/compose?text=...`) as a workaround. It didn't open the composer. It opened an in-app browser showing "Oops! Unable to resolve handle" on bsky.app, so the simulator is now on that error page rather than the home feed.

I also noticed a `cliclick` binary in a shim directory. I didn't use it, because the instructions say host mouse and keyboard automation is unavailable and I shouldn't work around that.

To finish, one of these is needed:
- A tap/type-capable tool (for example `idb`, or an XCUITest runner) so I can press the compose button, type "testing hashtags #silverbench", and press Post.
- Or you could do the last few taps yourself: tap the blue compose button, enter the text, and publish.
